description_en: Queries the handling scenarios for alerts triggered by the same rule or type
description_zh: 查询相同规则或类型触发的告警的处理场景
name: DescribeSimilarEventScenarios

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert event.
You can call the [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
告警事件的ID。
您可以调用[DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: security_event_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Scenarios.description_en: The list of handling scenarios for alerts of the same type
Scenarios.description_zh: 相同告警事件的处理场景列表

items.description_en: The handling scenario for alerts of the same type
items.description_zh: 相同告警事件的处理场景

Code.description_en:
The code of the handling scenario. Valid values:
default: same alerting type
same_file_content: same file content rule
same_ip: same IP rule
same_url: same URL rule
Code.description_zh:
处理场景的Code值。取值：
default：相同告警类型
same_file_content：相同文件内容规则
same_ip：相同IP规则
same_url：相同URL规则
